label: ABILITY_TO_BE_1: CanBe x r: x is able to be r, as the knower who is not contemplating is able to…
definition: `CanBe x r`: x is able to be r, as the knower who is not contemplating is able to contemplate and the wood is able to have the Hermes cut out of it. A primitive of the Metaphysics IX.6 analysis of potency; it says nothing about whether x is actually r, and nothing in the case constrains it beyond that analysis.
note: Sense fork batch 3 (POTENCY_3): CapacityPotency CanBe x r := CanBe x r is the sense's own declaration, so that capacity statements mention neither adopted nor independent potency. The CanBe parameter of PotencyIsUnactualizedCapacityReading is the same relation.

formal_gap.meaning: CapacityPotency CanBe x r is the capacity sense of potency (POTENCY_3): x is able to be r, whether or not it is r now, as a knower who is not contemplating can contemplate. Its body only applies the supplied relation CanBe, the primitive of the Metaphysics IX.6 analysis, so its content is that relation.
examples: A knower not now contemplating, with r contemplating.
Wood that can have a Hermes cut out of it.
exclusions: Adopted potency (DEF-POTENCY, CanBe x r ∧ ¬ InAct x r): capacity alone does not exclude being actually r (DISAMB-POTENCY).
Modal possibility at an alternative world: the passage from CanBe to accessible actuality is the separate open premise ModalCapacity (DISAMB-CAN-BE-MODAL-CAPACITY).
Active power to produce r in another.
open_obligations: Nothing in the case constrains CanBe beyond the IX.6 analysis (PotencyIsUnactualizedCapacityReading).
The bridge to modal capacity remains open, and its failure is kept as an option in the RootExposure fork.
No formalization candidate: CanBe is the basic capacity notion from which adopted potency is defined.
